claims.claim_text: This section sets out the governance disclosures required for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Present as a framing statement; not a substantive disclosure of governance arrangements.

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities have not been identified in this section.
claims.support_notes: The section explicitly states the oversight body/individuals are not identified; therefore related IFRS S1 governance oversight disclosures are not provided.

claims.claim_text: This section does not describe how responsibilities for sustainability-related risks and opportunities are reflected in terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions or related policies.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(a)(i).

claims.claim_text: This section does not describe how appropriate skills and competencies are determined or developed for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(a)(ii).

claims.claim_text: This section does not describe how and how often the governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed about sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(a)(iii).

claims.claim_text: This section does not describe how sustainability-related risks and opportunities are taken into account when overseeing strategy, major transactions and risk management processes (including consideration of trade-offs).
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(a)(iv).

claims.claim_text: This section does not describe how targets are overseen and progress monitored, including whether and how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(a)(v).

claims.claim_text: Management’s role in the governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related risks and opportunities has not been described in this section.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly states management role is not described; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(b)(i)-(ii).

claims.claim_text: This section does not specify whether management’s role is delegated to a specific management-level position or committee, or how oversight is exercised.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not specified; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(b)(i).

claims.claim_text: This section does not specify whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, or how these are integrated with other internal functions.
claims.support_notes: Explicitly stated as not specified; indicates non-coverage of IFRS S1 27(b)(ii).

claims.claim_text: The governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities are not identified in this section.
claims.support_notes: The text explicitly addresses sustainability-related risks/opportunities, not climate-related specifically. Absence for climate-related governance cannot be conclusively inferred from this section alone.

claims.claim_text: Management’s role in governance processes, controls and procedures for monitoring, managing and overseeing climate-related risks and opportunities is not described in this section.
claims.support_notes: The section states non-disclosure for sustainability-related risks/opportunities generally; it does not explicitly state climate-related non-disclosure.
